notes.title: Incoming Transmission: MAJOR UPDATE #2 is HERE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/caa44fd2ce5ef42a2d63653104324f9a75bc8a63.png[/img]
Artwork by Maxim Yasko

[h3]We've been hard at work on the next major content update for Iron Meat, and we're super excited to finally be able to show you what we've been up to!

Let's jump right into the MEAT of it all:[/h3]

[h1][b]NEW CONTENT[/b][/h1]
[h2][b]New Modes[/b][/h2]
[h3]1. Boss Rush[/h3]
Challenge the fearsome, gore-tastic boss monsters from every mission in the game! Choose what weapons you want to equip at the start of every fight. Like the normal playthrough mode, your life count will be based on what difficulty you select beforehand. However, lose all your lives and you'll be given the option to start at the VERY BEGINNING once again, or you can call it quits! Pick up your favorite pair of weapons and go hunting for those boss monsters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/f318afcf57bcc4731cd5933c01e5f729a9b3d65a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/e906359d2ff080386c004678ddfea3cf8f41b5df.png[/img]
[h3]2. Arcade[/h3]
As a highly requested mode by you, our community, we've added an Arcade mode to the game. This mode will establish a limit on how many Continues you can do, which will vary based on the difficulty you select. As it stands, you will have: 6 Continues on Easy, 4 Continues on Normal, and only 2 Continues on Hard. Otherwise, the playthrough is largely the same--you'll still gain a new life every 20,000 points, and you'll still encounter the same enemies, weapon drops, point drops, and upgrade drops as you would in a normal playthrough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/3515e9c9fa6653cfea1480b1935b51aad9280044.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/b06abc4a18fdac985274fd48b49cbbe7898cd0f5.png[/img]
[h3]3. Mutation[/h3]
Experience Iron Meat in a whole new way in Mutation Mode! Add even MORE infected Meat humans to join the fray, choose which weapon upgrades appear across levels--and which ones appear as just point drops, turn on AUTOMATIC FIRING, or summon forth a whole swath of Meat Hands that will truly force you to Run and Gun!
Here's a list of every setting that will appear in Mutation Mode:
[olist]
[*] [b]Arms Race[/b]: Giant Meat Hands chase the player from the left of the screen. Players can alter how many actual hands appear.
[*] [b]Bubble Trouble[/b]: Normal infected enemies can produce toxic bubbles on death. You can set how prolific these toxic bubbles will be--you can also set whether enemies produce small or large amounts of bubbles on death.
[*] [b]Blats Party[/b]: Adds flying enemies (i.e. Blats and Dragonflies) into every applicable level, where you can also set how many you want to see appear (only one at a time, or a group that appears frequently).
[*] [b]Horde Control[/b]: This setting alters the frequency of common Meat-infected humans appearing on screen. Use the slider to increase or decrease their overall quantity.
[*] [b]Favorite Weapon[/b]: Pre-select your starting weapon that you'll begin every level with. Note: Setting this to active will only allow you to pick ONE (1) weapon to start with at the beginning of every level. You can also choose to start with a weapon at its 2nd tier (Green Projectiles)!
[*] [b]Active & Nonactive Weapons[/b]: Pick and choose which weapon upgrades will change into Score Pick-Ups instead of Weapon Pick-Ups.
[*] [b]Firing Speed (Slower or Faster)[/b]: Set a custom rate of fire for any weapon you use to be slower (set slider to the left) or faster (set slider to the right) than normal.
[*] [b]Enable Auto-Fire[/b]: Setting this to active will allow the player(s) to never stop firing the weapon currently active.
[*] [b]Infinite Upgrade Time / No 2nd Weapon Slot[/b]: This setting allows players to keep their Supercharge upgrade (Rapid Fire), retaining their red projectiles as well. However, setting this to active will also remove the second weapon slot, so you will only be able to have a single weapon equipped at any given time.
[*] [b]Set Custom Life Count[/b]: Choose the default number of lives players will always start with at the beginning of every level.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/7acb42b6973b114c7b054f563920c4a34bbbc7bc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/f499a288fabef87c5ba9900b411e1172fa4c5b03.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/bf6149c0d9f6839bed8536cc0c0e900b0da80490.png[/img]
We are pleased to serve players a fine platter of customizable settings, and we hope you enjoy all that these (and future?) settings have to offer!

[h2][b]New Weapons[/b][/h2]
[h3]"F" Gun (The Flamethrower)[/h3]
A unique weapon first seen in Iron Meat's end credits animation. We decided to retool it to function with multiple fireballs that will follow the player's aim. While obviously ineffective when facing enemies at a range, the Flamethrower serves it purpose in controlling massive hordes of Meat-infected humans running onto the scene from either side! Starting out, this weapon's base color is orange. Upgraded once, it'll turn a bright blue. Upgraded a third time, or by obtaining the Supercharge pick-up, its color will change to an otherworldly green hue! Turn up the heat against the Meat with this all-new weapon!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/34b33ef1cb994743b160a634b9c1dabe6339d9d4.gif[/img]

[h3]"P" Gun (Particle Gun)[/h3]
This weapon rapidly fires the energy stored within its rounds into smaller bits encased with lethal plasma. Like its other weapon brethren, this model is outfitted to fire blue-tinted rounds, with its upgraded version changing them to green. However, unlocking this weapon's third tier through Supercharge will somehow change its projectiles into dark red Meat rounds, which a few deranged agents of ours have colloquially coined as the "Bacon Gun."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/bfa8446b2f5b3f565f27bad2ea347be315b3ad66.gif[/img]
[h2][b]New Enemy Type[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Wall-Crawling Zombies[/b][/h3]
Officers infected by the Meat will appear in either foreground or background elements to either jump down or pull themselves up onto the stage area! Be on the lookout for those Meat-ified humans donning officer uniforms and take them out before they run into you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/a89dc7866a2f1e9018b1131dcbc9fe4a80f7a3d9.gif[/img]
And there you have it! We hope you'll look forward to trying out all the new modes, playing with the new weapons, and facing down those crawling Meat zombies in Iron Meat's next major update!

[h3][b]This update is live RIGHT NOW and will be available for all other platforms very soon![/b][/h3]

And check out our update video on YouTube that goes through what's in this update:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kUz4LWgrTv4

Be sure to follow Retroware's developer page to stay up-to-date on all our games, news, and more!
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Retroware

[h3]And, for one WHOLE WEEK, you can get Iron Meat now at 25% OFF as part of a Steam Daily Deal! Play the newest update to the game today![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1157740/Iron_Meat/

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE #1
notes.content:
[h2]INCOMING TRANSMISSION![/h2]
[h3]//Major Update #1 Initializing...[/h3]

We're super excited to release the first major update to Iron Meat! From a new color added to show off when Supercharge is active, to a MIRROR MODE, in addition to minor bug fixes, you can take on the hordes of Meat monsters in a whole new way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/482f8ece961c4fcf54c67f816e7cb251e1967d51.gif[/img]
[h3][b]Updates List:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Mirror Mode has been added - Unlocked after completing the game for the first time. You can now play through every level of the game with the x-axis flipped. Enemies and bosses function the same, but this time you'll be running to your LEFT!
[*]The Supercharge mode (Rapid Fire) will now automatically activate if you collect a third copy of an already equipped gun.
[*]Bullets fired while in Supercharge mode will now appear as RED.
[*]Sections of all levels have been slightly changed to be more fair to the player (example: Meat Worms are now killable in Base the second they appear, the Meat Mouth door spawners on Train are now killable).
[*]Increased the default damage of the "E", "U", and "M" guns.
[*]Enhanced background visuals (i.e. helicopter firing on Meat monsters in Forest, added spikes to miniboss on Base, surviving pilots added to credits animation scroll, explosion impacts from meteors on Train).
[*]You can now keep any extra lives you earned if you finish a level with more lives than you started with.
[*]MI-24 helicopter boss fight has been retooled to be more clear.
[*]More MEAT has been added to Moon Base.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/f9670759a5f4884dffef63897fc4a73050f8333e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/e1f0880944fdbf6f1ea32471f12a907f29ef0001.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/fa2236eaa435ee88a599e0e06ad3dad66d55dbaa.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/0b07b3c814640beedb7892b0eb349ca73e358c24.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/ed97552ce9da5b6337095d88c62d6aa8041ba67e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/5d1acffce6efde7d8e343aa96f7e0e8efc425fa1.gif[/img]
We hope you'll enjoy challenging yourselves in Mirror Mode, blasting enemies with Supercharge, and all the other updates we've added to the game, and be on the lookout for when the next major update drops!

Jump into the action and play Iron Meat now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1157740/Iron_Meat/

Be sure to follow Retroware's developer page to stay up-to-date on all our games, news, and more!

https://store.steampowered.com/developer/retroware

notes.title: Interview: Sitting Down with Our Senior QA Tester!
notes.content:
This week, we chat with Christian Czmar, our Senior QA Tester, as we delve into what it was like in the earlier builds of Iron Meat and what's it like post-launch!

[h3]Please introduce yourself and describe your involvement in Iron Meat's development.[/h3]
Christian: Hi! I'm Christian "Siz" Czmar, I'm the Senior Game Tester at Retroware. My involvement with Iron Meat for the last 2 years has been trying to break it and then try to figure out how to make sure that I can't break it the same way again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/901feaadb29569f1c60126bb9e0ed62afcf85d8c.png[/img]

[h3]How does it feel to see a game you tested from its earlier builds to now where it's available to the world?[/h3]
Christian: It's incredible, especially with the reception it's gotten. I was also on the Prison City team and that felt great, too, but to have people be so passionate this time around has been a nice cherry on top.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/9fcc7085eb02f670af611411816d263512fe3dad.gif[/img]

[h3]What were some notable bugs you found during the early builds you tested? How about a bug or two that you noticed later on in the near-final builds of the game?[/h3]
Christian: By the time Iron Meat had gotten into my hands it was already way ahead in terms of polish, Ivan had been working on it already for years so a lot of the basic stuff I'm used to finding had been worked out. I think the most notable early bug was player 2 and player 1 having different hit boxes. I'm not sure what caused this to happen but some attacks were impossible to dodge as player 2 in those first builds I got. For example the laser attack on the first boss--even ducking, player 2 would die there no matter what. Between then and now, it was mostly just layering bugs--the player appearing in front of foreground assets and such. The last major bug (hopefully) was one a few people certainly noticed with Sasha not showing up at the end of the game. Apparently, she didn't like it when players took lives from their friends after the final boss fight. The worst part of the job is there's always something you didn't run into that eventually will be found in the thousands of other playthroughs that happen after release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/7682297125fda98a8ea2dad3b290ae424599fbcd.png[/img]

[h3]As a Senior QA Tester, how would you describe the experience of testing the game across multiple platforms?[/h3]
Christian: I mean, it's not fun haha. We tried to get this out on as many platforms and distributors as we could, and each and every one of those has different requirements and expectations that they absolutely need or they won't let you release. Whenever some backend change is made to some version of the game to meet a requirement, that means there's a new build and that means I need to do another test to see if that change broke something somewhere else. I swear there was like 20 builds for PlayStation in a row where there was no visible change on my end but were all essential to being approved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/827f75431345dd6e76a63cda032e174f2967147f.png[/img]

[h3]After going through the game countless times, which level do you think you've run through the most? Any favorite or least favorite bosses? And your preferred weapons?[/h3]
Christian: I think it would be Tower. That had a few achievement hang ups that left us confused on what the issue was. That happened a few times, I think every achievement in Tower, besides the one for beating it, were bugged at one point or the other, haha. My favorite boss is probably the Carrionvoy; it just has such a great presence. My least favorite is probably Big Rig; that's probably just 'cause it's given me the most Game Over's besides The Iron Meat itself. My go-to weapon is for sure is the Spread Shotgun (S). Get that baby fully upgraded and you've got such a wide burst at long distance and can deal crazy damage up close. You can't go wrong with it. Thank me later.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/5859610aa03371a5498de0363e14949b1a3dfc70.gif[/img]

[h3]Lastly, if you could add a new feature to Iron Meat, what do you think would be a great addition?[/h3]
Christian: If I could add a feature it would probably be something like an Iron Man mode where your lives stay at a consistent count between levels. I'm glad they reset each level by default because we want as many people as possible to play and enjoy, but I can see the sickos out there who want to challenge themselves, yes you I see YOU! If it's in the cards to happen, I think it would make some people happy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/9833619d97088daa699377bd3486fe84326ef4c6.gif[/img]

Check back here for even more updates! Iron Meat is available now!

Be sure to follow Retroware's developer page to stay up-to-date on all our games, news, and more!

https://store.steampowered.com/developer/retroware

notes.title: Change That Background!
notes.content:
You can change the main menu background into 1 of 3 different variants! Each one tells a different story, depending on your progress in the game! Beating every mission and reaching the ending will allow you to change your main menu background to any of the three variants!

[h3]1. The Lunar Research Base[/h3]
In the default background, we see scientist Yuri Markov working in his laboratory on the Moon as he studies the Meat cell in containment. Throughout the animation, we see other scientists walking around, along with Sasha carrying some equipment--likely a Meat sample perhaps? Soldiers seen in the lab stand at attention and salute as Sasha passes them. Out the window, we see ships moving about the lunar station, oblivious to the tragedy about to unfold...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/ac50dcd5fa70fa1fab41c87d961890b12eaf87e4.gif[/img]

[h3]2. Lab in Shambles[/h3]
When playing through Iron Meat for the first time, you'll notice the background reflects the tattered remnants of Markov's lab--now decimated and overrun with tendrils and growths of Meat spores! We see infected humans running around, along with Blats and Dragonflies! Outside, a Meatified spaceship lumbers past the ruined the laboratory window; suffice to say that "spaceship" is probably a LIVING THING now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/52865f7687e9385aedc827f2ad831898cea7f97a.gif[/img]

[h3]3. Blood Ring[/h3]
After completing the game the first time around, you'll be greeted by a third background variant: a distant view of Earth with a blood ring orbiting around it! Following Vadim and Sasha's escape from the Moon, our celestial neighbor detonates, thanks to the latter's bomb-planting efforts. The remains of the Moon's fleshy innards now circle our planet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/acd92bbb205e917ceb62356d41c99e931fa6e311.gif[/img]

Surely, with the Meat cell gone and the Moon destroyed, this marks the final end of the Meat and a new beginning for humanity...

...Right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/8e0f441e2589e8ddd112ce55df925e946cc33aa0.png[/img]

Check back here for even more Iron Meat updates!

Be sure to follow Retroware's developer page to stay up-to-date on all our games, news, and more!

notes.content:
[h2]INCOMING TRANSMISSION: PATCH NOTES #1[/h2]

[b]Attention, soldiers! We've got the first round of patch notes here!
[/b]
[b][h3]Updates[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*]Added an "Additional Art" section to the credits listing other artists who contributed to some of the character sprites.[/list]
[b][h3]Fixes[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*]Balanced the attack pattern values for certain phases during the final boss fight based on growing player feedback on its difficulty.
[*]Fixed an issue where Sasha does not appear on the final level of the game after one player takes a 1UP from the other, which would cause a softlock.

[/list]
We'll be keeping an eye out for even more feedback from players and will move to address any significant issues that may pop up! In the meantime, check back here for more updates, and don't forget to get consumed by the hordes of Meat monsters threatening the planet! MEAT!

notes.title: Play Iron Meat with Steam Remote Play!
notes.content:
Why choose to take on the hordes of Meat monsters alone? What if you don't have anyone to jump into the action with IN-PERSON?

[h3]Enter STEAM REMOTE PLAY![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/182d4b3eca6202ca284589e30cd9bbc2291659c0.gif[/img]

With Steam Remote Play, you can have another player join you online by having them connect to your game session!

In this way, you'll be able to play the game together, as if the other player were there with you! Wow!

Please refer to this page to get Steam Remote Play working for you on your preferred device: https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay/#:~:text=Remote%20Play%20Together.%20Invite%20Anyone.


[h3]To play Iron Meat using Steam Remote Play on PC, you can follow these steps:[/h3]
1. Launch [i]Iron Meat[/i].
2. Make sure your friend is logged in to Steam from their PC.
3. Open your Steam Overlay while in-game (Shift + Tab).
4. From your Friends List, right-click your friend and select "Remote Play Together".
5. Once your friend accepts the invite, they should be able to join you in-game!

For a more detailed explanation, and for any issues encountered, please refer to: https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/0689-74B8-92AC-10F2#howdoiuseit


Facing down the hordes of Meat with a friend is always better than having to battle them alone! So you can grab a buddy--remotely!--and take on the bloody, gore-ridden levels of Iron Meat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/228be1105a1e31a6da1b69df0d27a7ebaf49f544.gif[/img]

[h3]Iron Meat is available NOW![/h3]

Take on the menacing hordes of Meat monsters as you blast your way through 9 levels of gory devastation amidst a dire invasion of Earth! Bringing back a scrumptious serving of classic run and gun mechanics, alongside a platter of features like in-game achievements, unlockable and customizable skins, and local 2-player couch co-op (and Steam Remote Play), [i]Iron Meat[/i] is a modern retro experience that joyously welcomes players of all skill levels into its bloody jaws of gameplay!

notes.title: New, Updated Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
[h3]We are pleased to announce the release of a new, updated demo for Iron Meat! Have a look at some of the details![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/8223dd773f00cc0ea3e598d3463c0322b3c8af80.gif[/img]

[h2]New Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*][u][b]2D Intro Animation:[/b][/u] What used to be exclusive to our game trailers and at live showcase events can now be enjoyed by ALL players in the new demo! This amazing 2D animation puts you in the perspective of Vadim, a soldier of the Earth Counter Invasion Force (ECIF), as he battles The Meat across multiple environments you can expect to see in the final game!
[*][u][b]New Opening Cutscene:[/b][/u] How the hell did The Meat invasion start anyway? Well, this new in-game cutscene answers just that! Players will be able to see how scientist Yuri Markov and lunar soldier Sasha begin their roles in Iron Meat's visual story! We hope you enjoy this narrative addition to the demo!

[b]Opening Story:[/b] As Yuri Markov studies The Meat at his research base on the Moon, the entity suddenly breaks out, takes control of the scientist, and begins wreaking havoc! Rushing onto the scene is Sasha--a veteran soldier who sends a signal to Earth warning the ECIF about the impending invasion! But as Sasha transmits her message, a horde of Meat creatures arrives, prompting her to abandon the lab and search for any other humans on the Moon Base! As Markov unleashes The Meat invasion upon Earth, we find ourselves at a military base already under attack!

[*][u][b]Fixes & Technical Updates:[/b][/u]
- Updated gamepad support
- Fixed a visual issue showing the wrong life-count
- Fixed responsiveness of game on multiple screen resolutions
- Other performance enhancements
- English, Russian, and Portuguese languages now supported in-game, with even more localizations coming in the final version
- Removal of City: While the City level is no longer playable, we wanted to showcase all the visual and internal changes from all the work we've been doing! Players can look forward to playing on City again when the game launches later this year!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/5d48ed0f7fe26866a88d16f6945610813aab9ff8.gif[/img]

notes.title: Flying Cars...That Bite?!
notes.content:
Who says the Meat has no taste for cars? Well, actually it doesn't; it'll infect and assimilate any and all vehicles, to be honest--BUT HEY! Let's take a look!

[h3][b]Make, Model, and MEAT![/b][/h3]
You'll notice not all infected cars have the same shape--that's because the Meat isn't particularly fond of any one style!...Or maybe it just doesn't care; it just wants to CONSUME.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/614c203c3f48619669409e119a0c67fa6b38b74c.png[/img]
[h3][b]"Dead" Driver!...No, ACTUALLY a Dead Driver![/b][/h3]
It is not for the faint of heart to think about how the last moments of sanity were like for any infected drivers found within Meat-assimilated cars. Now, you'll see them shooting fiery projectiles out of their heads, or wielding handguns already equipped by their former human selves! Being too far gone with their monstrous vehicles, you'll have to eliminate them, too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/e33368240b072a057acbc6ec8739162532f75342.gif[/img]
[h3][b]Raining Fire![/b][/h3]
Refashioned after undergoing Meat assimilation, some flying cars will now have the ability to launch missiles from under their hoods! You can destroy these as they descend to try and reach you, or you can show off your dodging skills!  (We recommend the former!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/2563587695d2479fbed159e3adf7961818b301cd.gif[/img]
Stay tuned for even more updates as we continue on with development!

Be sure to follow Retroware's publisher page to stay up-to-date on all our games, news, and more!

notes.title: A Little Bit of This & That!
notes.content:
You’ll be able to earn a host of different Skins in Iron Meat–you can even unlock a handful now in the demo! But we wanted to take a step further and allow players to fully customize their in-game appearance by mixing and matching different parts of the player-character!

When selecting your player-character, the four outer arrows on the left and right will change individual parts, while the two inner arrows will change up the whole Skin to the next one available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/ef0c7ab94c4630f657f8ee5b2cc6cdd8002509df.gif[/img]
You can swap out the chest, either arm, legs, and the head of your character to any other available Skin you’ve unlocked! Not in the mood to play as Vadim? That’s OK! Change it up with having Franklin legs, a Poochie left arm, an ECIF Soldier right arm, a Power Armor chest, and…well…a Vadim head!

There are so many Skin combinations you’ll be able to come up with as you earn more Skins! Here’s just a few permutations we messed around with ourselves in the demo!

[h3][b]1. Franklin the Armored Fighter![/b][/h3]
He came from another dimension to help out against The Meat. Don’t ask questions; just be thankful he’s on our side!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/d36d1e8ab8d7670f8d2d8b5e325c0be76c8e05dc.png[/img]
[h3][b]2. They Call Him…The Hunter![/b][/h3]
He doesn’t appreciate questions about his tail. Consider him as more of a lone bounty hunter who joined up with the Earth Counter Invasion Force for the money! Give ‘em a gun, and he’ll get the job done!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/f82219baf87d014e654d2144e5b7465851e4ce71.png[/img]
[h3][b]3. Extra THICCC![/b][/h3]
[i][b]THIIIIICCCCC!!![/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/7e212afa163a4215bd2ca6932b79164753b8d734.png[/img]
We’re excited to share more as we continue along with development!

notes.title: Another Look at the Railway of Death
notes.content:
Get a glimpse at what to expect from the newly updated Train level in the Iron Meat demo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/7bf347481050b468966f897212192bbd63c5ac38.gif[/img]
[h3][b]1. From Clean to Infected![/b][/h3]
Originally, all of the flying cars in this level were untouched by The Meat plague. But now, you can look forward to these flying monsters of flesh and crude designs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/8f933f33a963f3eb1c2c6f2cd54bd5345644da06.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/f26169dbd0bc850339b7bc634273418b586b288b.png[/img]
[h3][b]2. Goodnight, Moon…Wait, What Happened to the MOON?![/b][/h3]
Before the update, you may have noticed the crescent moon in the background as you progressed through the Train level. This time, we’ve added some detail to highlight the fact that our once docile celestial pal has now become the den of MEAT!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/fc147a651e28b6dffb3db79863ae8a522ae5bdca.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/03fa95576b9f47a16221e36e5ef8d68ba0a84b75.png[/img]
As a bonus, you’ll also notice the Meat Headlaunchers that once took aim from inside the passenger cars have now been replaced by half-human, half-snakelike monsters! Same difference! Just aim and fire!

[h3][b]3. Take This With You![/b][/h3]
One easy-to-miss change is that passing police cars will now drop weapon upgrades for Vadim! Use these to your advantage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/e9134a5f6e0678fba653d13135a38949380b578a.png[/img]
[h3][b]4. Where’s the Body?![/b][/h3]
In lead developer Ivan’s words: “The Bubblemaker now has a corpse.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/699437447953264eabb7e965d6584f9ef6e2de95.png[/img]

Also from Ivan: “The small turrets have been removed because they are difficult to hit and hard to notice.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/1afa45500389e732fdeefc7fa68ff420dfb32460.png[/img]

notes.title: This Time, You Must Reveal the Monster Within!
notes.content:
Who made these renovations?! We're featuring the Monster House boss once again--now with a couple of updated looks and attacks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/2680d20ea0295a2763003d645111899d1145f537.gif[/img]
[h2][b]1. Four Mouths, Four Fireballs[/b][/h2]
One of the most notable changes to this boss includes its initial attack, featuring four mouths embedded into its walls! Rather than launching a spread of fireballs from its central eye, each of the mouths will spew out one fireball!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/8a3faa421f7157d100139d81657b0259088c72fa.gif[/img]
[h2][b]2. Falling Debris[/b][/h2]
In addition, what was once a separate “attack” in its previous version has now combined with the first! As you dodge the fireballs coming from the four mouths, be mindful of the falling building debris–indicated by the redesigned red target marks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/3baf7706e90f3e99c5a63c4397628fa18cdd7701.gif[/img]
[h2][b]3. The Twins, Unchanged[/b][/h2]
Next, it’s the same twins you know and love from the original version of the fight! You can expect the orange fireball patterns from the left, and the blue cascading fireballs from the right!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/7ea070c7ca32e1915a7d1a6aaeaf9672eaf00f69.gif[/img]
[h2][b]4. Spinning Twins, Once More[/b][/h2]
And like the previous attack, this one’s more of the same, as well. The twin appendages will spin around each other, causing one fireball to cascade on the platform, while the other tries to track the player’s position!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/ba390502fc0b1cc9896585d747b186e8ec0dc73e.gif[/img]
[h2][b]5. Revealing the Monster[/b][/h2]
After defeating the appendages, the building wall will collapse, revealing the familiar eyeball monstrosity within! Just like the previous version of the fight, you’ll want to target the central eyeball with your shots! Beware of the spawning Blats and Dragonflies in the meantime!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/f879052a4109633bb63cbecc9563a444a5216aaf.gif[/img]
You can face the newly updated Monster House boss in the Iron Meat demo available NOW!

notes.title: The Tank Boss - Revisited
notes.content:
Get an in-depth look at the Forest level’s Tank Boss following the demo’s latest update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/aa488d5b1c9cfc5c51a67a1b91f7bd6fc504730b.gif[/img]

One of the first design changes was having the boss enter from the right as usual, but now we’ve added dead and infected bodies on the ground to give a sense of dread at the first boss fight.

[h2][b]Updated Visuals - Old and New![/b][/h2]
The boss itself has undergone a significant redesign! We wanted to move away from presenting the Tank as just a...well, tank...that was overgrown with Meat tendrils and flesh. Lead game developer Ivan took things a step further by giving the boss a gaping mouth and eyes to make it even more frightening!

[b]OLD VERSION:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/fe6da23c01240bbe26dace088c176c8b33e80cbf.png[/img]
[b]NEW VERSION:[/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/e0262e3aaf39488449a676331238976a0b24eda0.png[/img]
[h2][b]Meat Round & Energy Cannon![/b][/h2]
One big change to the Tank boss pertains to its opening attack, where it used to fire two energy projectiles from its main and lower cannons. HOWEVER! The updated demo now replaces the top energy projectile with a solid Meat round, which, like the blue energy projectile in the previous version, will float up and down after it’s fired.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/344b672daf7b3f3f3a72d24d97cc2608a54407d1.gif[/img]
[h2][b]Double Particle Radiation Beam![/b][/h2]
Another change involves the Tank boss’s second attack, which further punishes any player who is foolish enough to jump. While the attack may look cool, you’ll still want to go prone to avoid the radiation beams!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/e3c1b0dd342167d4d8bd27f9a7740bf4163f7f7b.gif[/img]
[h2][b]Toxic Rain - Once Again![/b][/h2]
One attack that hasn’t gone through any significant changes is the Toxic Rain! Like the previous version of the fight, the boss will shoot out multiple toxic bubbles that will multiply into even more bubbles as they descend towards the ground! And just like the previous version, you’ll want to shoot at the bubbles in the air to eliminate them before they reach you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/978a49db89dc2b9bcebf22a3f219a8be27790999.gif[/img]
We've got more updates on the way, so be on the lookout for the next transmission!

Wishlist Iron Meat and play the new, updated demo available NOW!

notes.title: Who’s Running this Train?!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/91b758d3262b8cc8bbff5db309a4b3f0de1597fb.gif[/img]
[h3][b]WARNING: Passengers May be Infected Personnel![/b][/h3]
Get ready to fight against hordes upon hordes of Meat-infected Humans, vehicles, and other monstrosities on board this train!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/8540b55cb8b4c6f55262f12c032cd74d42080d7f.png[/img]
Watch out for infected Humans riding on stolen jet bikes! They’ll constantly fire orange plasma projectiles at Vadim, so don’t let them linger for too long!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/8a552683128b964ae4dc428a3aaf2543bf4bef54.png[/img]
[h3][b]Onboard Obstacles[/b][/h3]
You’ll find a host of new Meat obstacles much unlike those found in the Forest level. For starters, you’ll find a few “Eyesticks” making a new home for themselves on some rail platforms and box cars. These function like turrets and they fire spinning diamond projectiles! Eliminate these eyesores and keep moving!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/c761ceb8e26f741154f99ea7a3406c5ad6ca9eb4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/c24017a7b276a688fa097658639a84700db50b83.png[/img]
Take the low road when they take the high road! Some box cars are passable through the inside–meaning, you can choose to go through them rather than moving on their tops. The catch is: you’ll find the interiors taken over by ravenous Meat Incisors! These mouths will constantly chomp away as they wait for new prey to chew on. These obstacles can’t be shot at or destroyed, so time it right and run through them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/402f2effe9c5bdea8280879f51e174b37f812651.png[/img]
Waiting at the middle of the level is a fleshy outgrowth consuming a piece of mechanical debris! You can see that its tendrils have all but expanded through the couple of passenger cars it now inhabits. Similar to the Meatified Tank from the Forest level, when detecting nearby prey, this Meat amalgamation will secrete toxic bubbles into the air to poison any ill-equipped foes. Shoot these bubbles out of the air before they get to you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/7682297125fda98a8ea2dad3b290ae424599fbcd.png[/img]
[h3][b]Floating Cars[/b][/h3]
As you travel along the tops of both normal and infected passenger carriages, you’ll come across multiple military cars commandeered by Meatified Humans!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/0fc6631345f675b08482a958b05071bd962d844a.png[/img]
Armed with the skills from their infected hosts, these monstrous Meat Humanoids can launch several rockets into the air and toward Vadim! Evade the rockets and blast these formerly allied vehicles to smithereens!

Oh, and you’ll want to watch your back, too! Hordes of Meat creatures will occasionally charge at Vadim from either side, so be careful!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/00557f71507e0373eb169571bfe7fe25f80f6d29.png[/img]
[h3][b]Iron Serpent Boss[/b][/h3]
At the very front of the train, you’ll find its head and the passenger cars closest to it have all been infected by The Meat! Take down this dangerous boss as it summons Blats, charges into walls, excretes blue plasma, and vomits the remains of its past victims!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/5859610aa03371a5498de0363e14949b1a3dfc70.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/e97cb54b5b48a2190719599733d929dc38ed08d8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/e0a594a2df4b1564cbcf9304d6625416a95907b9.png[/img]
We’re excited to share more as we continue on with Iron Meat’s development!

notes.title: “I’d Like to See Your Boss!” #1 - The Tank
notes.content:
[h3][b]// ALERT! "BOSS" CLASS ENEMY INBOUND! //[/b][/h3]

What was once a formidable battle tank for the Earth Counter Invasion Force has now become a henchman of The Meat!

[h3]Double Energy Cannons![/h3]
The first attack for this boss consists of two energy cannons firing two distinct rounds! The blue energy round, fired from the upper tank cannon, follows an irregular zigzagging pattern that goes up and down, while the orange round, fired from the lower emitter, follows a standard linear aim. Depending on the difficulty you're playing on, these energy rounds can be either slower or faster, so be sure to time your jumps when dodging!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/ebb2cd8049ac38680e9e39c7069384ac565af94e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/3aad3d21c40f61684a2a467ceb78365e183ee771.png[/img]
[h3]Particle Radiation Beam![/h3]
For its second attack, this boss will fire a single linear beam from its lower emitter! Unlike the previous dual attack, this one cannot be dodged by jumping, so be sure to GET DOWN when you see the warning aim line.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/0038b0248a386d4f98565e758f13108f835f6cc9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/9cb5681282ce9ef11ce6a2d58153d267abdd9ab0.png[/img]
[h3]Toxic Rain![/h3]
For its third and last attack, the boss will launch several rounds into the air from its “brain” at the back of its upper cannon. These rounds will then disperse a multitude of toxic bubbles that will rain down across the battlefield. Aim up and fire at the bubbles dropping towards you!

Tip: Weapons that cover a wide range, like the [b](B) Plasma Arc Blaster[/b] or the [b](S) Shotgun Spreader[/b] can be of immense utility in dealing with this attack!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/3d46286054b8c150487abaa886c524d71893ad54.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/0c5ddcc00298e136ba8b32e9270a419567bf6f58.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/8e0c748d18e444da9c1107eebda40a446381f8f0.png[/img]
[h3][b]// ATTENTION RECRUITS: We have a mission for you! //[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596640/fa9aaca55903f9cbb620a9540bd843c2a5ee69c6.png[/img]
Our intelligence officers have given this “boss” class enemy the working name of “Entrail Blazer MKII,” but the top brass wants a better name–one informed by firsthand accounts–for this threat!

That said, we need YOU to take on this boss and provide us with a more appropriate designation name for it! Firsthand accounts of the enemy will be much more useful to us rather than secondary sources and guesses!

So, jump into the Forest sector and give us your best idea to rename this boss! And who knows? If your idea makes the cut, we’ll reclassify the name of this boss to your idea!

****

We've got more updates on the way, so be on the lookout for the next transmission!

You can wishlist [i]Iron Meat[/i] and play the demo, available NOW!
